meanings.relic-ascension: Trigger shockwave pulse, shrine harmonic burst, and sovereign score surge
meanings.evasive-phase: Engage phase-shift lateral slipstream to evade imminent rival or hazard impact
meanings.frontier-attune: Synchronize serpent dorsal frequency with nearby open-world prism monolith shrine
meanings.apex-dominance: Command central arena lane with overdrive pressure and wide leaderboard lead
meanings.intercept-cut: Accelerate ahead of rival heading vector to force a lateral cut-off takedown
meanings.hyper-surge: Channel zero-drain hyper-core propulsion with expanded chase camera field of view
meanings.magnet-harvest: Project wide-radius orbital pull field to sweep radiant energy balls
meanings.chrono-cascade: Amplify orb growth and score harmonic multiplier across consecutive pickups
meanings.territorial-coil: Form defensive perimeter coil around high-density loot cluster against leviathans
meanings.steady-forage: Maintain balanced cruising cadence while harvesting ambient energy balls

spec.name: prism-serpent
spec.otherwiseWhy: Default balanced cruising posture collects radiant energy orbs without shedding mass.

properties.says: It always answers relic-ascension when pickup is apex-crown.
properties.why: Apex Crown relics unconditionally take top priority across both arena and open-world modes.

properties.says: It always answers evasive-phase when pickup is phase-cloak and threat is at least 60.
properties.why: High-threat phase cloak activation guarantees evasive phase protection.

properties.says: It always answers frontier-attune when mode is open-world and zone is sanctum-ring and threat is at most 30 and pickup is energy-orb.
properties.why: Peaceful arrival at Sanctum Ring in open-world mode always attunes the shrine.

properties.says: It never answers apex-dominance when threat is at least 60.
properties.why: Apex dominance is never advised under severe collision threat (>= 60).

properties.says: It always answers evasive-phase when mode is arena and pickup is energy-orb and rival is pack-hunter and boost is cruise and threat is at least 65.
properties.why: Unboosted arena serpents pressed by pack-hunters at >= 65 threat always evade.

properties.says: It never answers apex-dominance when mode is open-world.
properties.why: Open-world exploration never triggers competitive arena apex-dominance.

spec.purpose: Decides the tactical serpent directive, relic resonance state, rival interception posture, and open-world shrine response across the Neon Sovereign arena and frontier biomes.

rules.says: When pickup is apex-crown, the answer is relic-ascension.
rules.why: Collecting an Apex Crown relic immediately triggers sovereign shockwave ascension.

rules.says: When pickup is phase-cloak and threat is at least 60, the answer is evasive-phase.
rules.why: Phase cloak under high encroachment prioritizes ghost-phase collision immunity.

rules.says: When mode is open-world and zone is sanctum-ring and threat is at most 30, the answer is frontier-attune.
rules.why: Entering Sanctum Ring under calm threat in open-world mode attunes the central monolith.

rules.says: When mode is arena and length is at least 80 and boost is overdrive and threat is at most 55, the answer is apex-dominance.
rules.why: Long arena serpents boosting with controlled threat assert sovereign lane dominance.

rules.says: When mode is arena and rival is interceptor and boost is overdrive and length is at least 25, the answer is intercept-cut.
rules.why: Boosting against an interceptor rival with sufficient tail mass executes a cut-off.

rules.says: When mode is arena and rival is pack-hunter and threat is at least 65, the answer is evasive-phase.
rules.why: High-threat pack-hunter pincers require immediate evasive vector break.

rules.says: When pickup is hyper-core, the answer is hyper-surge.
rules.why: Hyper-Core unlocks zero-shedding maximum velocity surge.

rules.says: When pickup is magnet-prism, the answer is magnet-harvest.
rules.why: Magnet-Prism projects an electromagnetic orb-harvesting vortex.

rules.says: When pickup is chrono-shard, the answer is chrono-cascade.
rules.why: Chrono-Shard doubles harmonic score and segment growth yield.

rules.says: When mode is open-world and boost is cruise and threat is at most 25, the answer is frontier-attune.
rules.why: Calm cruising across open-world biomes activates harmonic wayfinding and shrine attunement.

rules.says: When length is at least 45 and rival is leviathan, the answer is territorial-coil.
rules.why: Mid-to-large serpents encountering a leviathan secure loot clusters by coiling.

rules.says: When boost is overdrive and length is at least 15, the answer is intercept-cut.
rules.why: Overdrive with sufficient body segments commits to aggressive lane cutting.
